thread:
carmen: Quick notice: we've updated the "Benefits Eligibility & Open Enrollment" handbook page and launched a short 7-minute enrollment verification micro-attestation for all benefits-eligible employees. Please complete by 2025-11-30. Link: https://handbook.redwood.company/benefits-open-enroll 

carmen: The update clarifies part-time eligibility, dependents documentation, and mid-year qualifying events. Attestation confirms you reviewed your benefits elections and dependent info. :page_with_curl:

leo: Do managers need to complete this, or just individual contributors who enroll?

carmen: Everyone benefits-eligible (including managers) gets the assignment. Managers also have an extra checkbox to confirm they've reminded their direct reports about dependent verification if applicable. That manager checkbox will show in the export.

maya: Contractors question: long-term contractors on payroll vs 1099? Who gets auto-assigned?

carmen: Only employees marked benefits-eligible in HRIS are auto-assigned. Long-term contractors who are on payroll and enrolled in benefits will be included. 1099s without benefits aren't assigned. If you think someone should be added, DM people-ops.

owen: For the tracker CSV, can we get `employee_email, manager_email, benefits_status, dependent_verified_at, attestation_completed_at, manager_reminder_sent`? Need to reconcile with benefits vendor.

carmen: Yes  that column set will be available. We'll include a `qualifying_event_flag` column too. Also adding `exemption_reason` for people who have proof of external coverage.

zoe: Is there an opt-out if someone has primary coverage through a spouse and already submitted proof earlier this year?

carmen: If you already submitted dependent documentation within the last 90 days, email benefits@redwood.com with proof and we'll mark `exemption_reason=external_coverage` in the tracker. Use subject: "Enrollment Exemption - [Name]".

hr-bot: Automated assignment: 256 employees assigned to "Benefits Enrollment Verification (7min)". Due: 2025-11-30. Tracker: https://docs.redwood.company/training-tracker (snapshot 2025-11-01 10:05 UTC) :bell:

leo: Reminders cadence? escalation?

carmen: Reminders at 10 days, 3 days, and 24 hours. Missed > 14 days = manager follow-up and a soft flag in the HR dashboard so benefits team can reach out. No punitive action for one miss; repeated misses addressed case-by-case.

maya: For managers exporting the CSV, can we include a `location` column to filter by country for vendor reconciliation?

carmen: Yep  `location` will be included. We'll drop the org CSV to #people-ops-managers on Monday after the first snapshot.

owen: Will the handbook have a changelog so I can paste a blurb into the HR weekly update?

carmen: Yes  changelog is at the bottom of the handbook page. Suggested blurb: "Updated Benefits Eligibility & Open Enrollment clarifications + 7-min verification attestation. Completion tracked; deadline 2025-11-30." Feel free to shorten.

zoe: Thanks. If people need an accommodation or more time for docs (e.g., overseas notarization), who do they contact?

carmen: Use benefits-accomms@redwood.com to request extensions or help. We'll reflect `extension_requested` in the CSV so managers and benefits can triage.

leo: I can volunteer to help triage flagged cases from our org. Ping me after Monday's export.

carmen: Great, thanks! I'll post the CSV and follow-up notes to #people-ops-managers. Appreciate the help. :sparkles:
